questions.question: How does Antoni Dudek propose to look at Wałęsa?
answers: Exclusively as a traitorous agent
Neither exclusively through rose-tinted nor exclusively through black glasses
Only as a holy hero
Exclusively through the prism of the Nobel Prize
questions.explanation: This is the basic thesis that opens and closes the whole text.

questions.question: What does the text regard as the most important reason for the positive balance of Wałęsa's life?
answers: His presidency after 1990
The role he played in the 1980s and in Solidarity
Exclusively the Nobel Peace Prize
His activity after 2000
questions.explanation: Dudek says the positive balance results above all from the 1980s.

questions.question: What problem is connected with the pseudonym "Bolek"?
answers: It concerns exclusively a false internet legend
It refers to Wałęsa's collaboration with the Security Service in the first half of the 1970s
It is the code name of the 1980 strike
It is the name of a political party
questions.explanation: The "Bolek" section describes the collaboration and its moral weight.

questions.question: Why does Wałęsa's presidency fare poorly in the text?
answers: Because he didn't want to run in the elections
Because he didn't understand the role of the president in a parliamentary system and destabilised politics
Because he emigrated immediately
Because he rejected the constitution in a referendum
questions.explanation: Dudek points to the lack of understanding of the political system and the conflict-ridden nature of the presidency.

questions.question: What, according to the text, particularly damaged Wałęsa's later image?
answers: Exclusively the activity of the West
The inability to admit to mistakes and his own megalomania
The lack of technical education
Refusing to accept the Nobel Prize
questions.explanation: Dudek stresses that Wałęsa hurt himself most after leaving office.
